course_name_original: PROGETTAZIONE ASSISTITA DI COMPONENTI MECCANICI T (87476)
course_name_en: COMPUTER-AIDED DESIGN OF MECHANICAL COMPONENTS T (87476)

learning_outcomes.text: The student will become familiar with the modeling, verification and validation of machine parts of varying complexity also through the use of calculation methodologies that make use of the computer.

The support of a three-dimensional and parametric CAD system will provide the student with the basis for deepening the morphological and functional characteristics of classical mechanical components and their composition in assemblies typical of mechanical constructions.

syllabus_topics: Definition of the modern design process contextualized to the various application areas.
The organization of the documentation and the construction concept.
General classification of the types of machines: customer expectations.
Verification of the components from a geometric point of view.
The verification of components and assemblies from the kineto-static point of view.
The evaluation of the overall reliability.
The planning of the maintenance process.
assessment_rules: The end-of-course exam assesses the achievement of educational objectives: knowing the design process, knowing the main CAD/CAE design tools, and knowing the main validation criteria of a project. The assessment includes validation of the project and an oral test on two specific questions related to the main course objectives, as well as an evaluation of the individual project.
bibliography: It is not necessary to purchase specific books. Up-to-date teaching material is provided in class, also available via username and password at AMS Campus - AlmaDL - University of Bologna.
